hook: Why are tankers burning at Hormuz?
caption:
🔥 Iran says at least three tankers hit mines near Hormuz; oil prices edged up, but the mine claim isn't independently verified.
🚧 Iran says the strait stays shut until the US meets 7 conditions.
✈️ US envoys Witkoff and Kushner landed in Moscow to meet Putin.
🗺️ Abu Dhabi talks ended with no breakthrough: territory is still the sticking point.
🇪🇺 Ukraine and the US want Europe in the talks; Russia says no.
🤝 Good news: a large prisoner swap is agreed, possibly over 1,000 on each side, according to Russia.

Should Europe have a seat at the table? Tell us below 👇
Follow @you.didnot.know for your daily brief.

2/5 US envoys land in Moscow (Putin)
Witkoff and Kushner landed in Moscow to meet Putin. It follows two days of US-mediated talks in Abu Dhabi.

Abu Dhabi talks ended without a major breakthrough. US mediators say the sides still disagree on territory.

4/5 Europe at the table? Russia: no (Europe)
Ukraine and the US want Europe in the peace talks. Russia opposes it, adding another open dispute.
📷 Håkan Dahlström from Malmö, Sweden (CC BY 2.0) via wikimedia

5/5 A big prisoner swap is agreed (1,000+)
Russia and Ukraine agreed a large prisoner-of-war exchange. Russia says over 1,000 each side; past swaps were smaller.
